1	const mongoose = require('mongoose')
2	
3	const transactionSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
4	  {
5	    user: { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'User', required: true },
6	    ticker: { type: String, required: true, uppercase: true },
7	    type: { type: String, enum: ['buy', 'sell'], required: true },
8	    shares: { type: Number, required: true, min: 0 },
9	    price: { type: Number, required: true, min: 0 },
10	    total: { type: Number, required: true },
11	    date: { type: Date, default: Date.now },
12	    notes: { type: String },
13	  },
14	  { timestamps: true }
15	)
16	
17	transactionSchema.index({ user: 1, date: -1 })
18	
19	module.exports = mongoose.model('Transaction', transactionSchema)
